Last Wednesday was all about copycat chocolate bars 🍫👀

We rolled, layered, coated, and created our own takes on a Canadian chocolate classic—with plenty of chocolate chaos along the way.

A huge thank you to everyone who joined us for this first-time workshop! 🙌
